data.one_liner: Maximum strictness Dart and Flutter static analysis configuration.
data.what_it_does: Enables every non-conflicting Dart lint rule and sets their severity to error, turning all violations into red squiggly lines in the IDE. Allows overriding specific rules in an analysis_options.yaml file.
use_when: You want maximum static analysis strictness in your Dart or Flutter project
You want all lint violations to show up as errors with red squiggles
avoid_when: You prefer warning levels over strict errors for lint rules
You are working on a legacy codebase where strict rules would cause excessive friction
strengths: Enforces strict code quality and consistency
Easy to customize by overriding individual rules in analysis_options.yaml
weaknesses: May break builds or add significant friction when new Dart versions add strict rules
Not for the faint-hearted due to maximum strictness
data.setup_notes: Include the package in your analysis_options.yaml file.

alternatives.name: lints
alternatives.why_pick_it: Official recommended lint rules from the Dart team which are less aggressive.

alternatives.name: flutter_lints
alternatives.why_pick_it: Official recommended lint rules specifically tailored for Flutter applications.
